# Tfa052 — ADVANCED_FACE split because surface area exceeds threshold (e.g., a 100x100 mm square face must be divided into bounded-area sub-faces)

## Sources
- OCCT `ShapeUpgrade_FaceDivideArea::Perform` (`ShapeUpgrade_FaceDivideArea.hxx:37`)

## Description

A single face whose surface area exceeds a caller-specified threshold; downstream meshing performance requires it be split into N sub-faces of bounded area. The N is computed from total area / threshold.

## Reproducer recipe

A 100x100 face when the caller supplies a maximum area of 100 mm² — must divide into ≥100 sub-faces.

## Expected kernel behavior

divide along U or V (or both) so each sub-face has area below threshold; preserve outer-wire connectivity.

## Notes

Variation of Tfa051 driven by area instead of continuity.
